name: HEAD-QA
intro: HEAD-QA是基于西班牙医疗系统专业资格考试的多项选择问答基准，涵盖医学、护理学、心理学、化学、药学和生物学六个领域，对人类专家也极具挑战性。
build_method: 官方考试题抽取、无效题清理、按年份切分与机器翻译人工抽检
eval_feature: 西班牙文/英文双语、按年份切分、与官方人类成绩可比
build_method_en: Official-exam extraction, invalid-item removal, chronological splitting, and human-audited machine translation
eval_feature_en: Spanish/English bilingual views, chronological splits, and comparability with official human results
intro_en: HEAD-QA is a multiple-choice question benchmark based on the Spanish healthcare system professional qualification exam, covering six fields: medicine, nursing, psychology, chemistry, pharmacy, and biology. It is highly challenging even for human experts.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1906.04701 and the official HEAD-QA release. HEAD-QA is created from Spanish public-health specialization examinations from 2013 onward. It covers medicine, pharmacology, psychology, nursing, biology, and chemistry; radiophysics is excluded because equations made PDF parsing difficult, and questions invalidated after the official exams are removed. Each sample stores a question ID/text, optional image path, answer IDs/text, and the correct-answer ID. The full dataset has 6,765 questions: 2,657 from 2013-2014 for training, 1,366 from 2015 for development, and 2,742 from later exams for testing. The original Spanish data is translated with Google API; two bilingual reviewers assess adequacy and one native English speaker assesses fluency on 60 random items. Evaluation selects one option and reports accuracy plus official POINTS (correct +3, wrong -1); no additional blank-answer rule is inferred.
